question: Mole Calculations - Mass and Moles
stem: How many moles of sodium hydroxide (NaOH) are present in 8.0 g of solid NaOH? [Ar: Na = 23, O = 16, H = 1]

question: Mole Calculations - Mass from Moles
stem: What is the mass of 0.15 mol of copper(II) sulfate (CuSO4)? [Ar: Cu = 64, S = 32, O = 16]

question: Molar Mass Determination
stem: A 0.25 mol sample of an unknown gas X has a mass of 11.0 g. Which of the following is gas X? [Ar: C = 12, N = 14, O = 16, S = 32]

question: Molar Volume of Gases
stem: What is the volume occupied by 0.050 mol of oxygen gas (O2) at room temperature and pressure (r.t.p.)? [Molar volume of gas at r.t.p. = 24 dm³/mol]

question: Molar Volume of Gases
stem: How many moles of ammonia gas (NH3) are present in 480 cm³ of the gas measured at r.t.p.?

question: Gas Volume from Mass
stem: What volume is occupied by 4.4 g of carbon dioxide gas (CO2) at r.t.p.? [Ar: C = 12, O = 16; Molar volume of gas at r.t.p. = 24 dm³/mol]

question: Gas Density and Molar Mass
stem: A gaseous hydride has a density of 1.25 g/dm³ at room temperature and pressure. What is the relative molecular mass (Mr) of the gas? [Molar volume of gas at r.t.p. = 24 dm³/mol]

question: Solution Concentration - mol/dm³
stem: A student dissolves 10.6 g of sodium carbonate (Na2CO3) in distilled water to make 250 cm³ of solution. What is the molar concentration of the solution? [Mr of Na2CO3 = 106]

question: Concentration Units Conversion
stem: A sample of dilute sulfuric acid (H2SO4) has a concentration of 49.0 g/dm³. What is its concentration in mol/dm³? [Mr of H2SO4 = 98]

question: Solution Dilution
stem: What is the final concentration when 50 cm³ of 2.0 mol/dm³ hydrochloric acid (HCl) is diluted with distilled water to a total volume of 250 cm³?

question: Mass of Solute in Solution
stem: What mass of potassium hydroxide (KOH) is dissolved in 200 cm³ of a 0.75 mol/dm³ KOH solution? [Ar: K = 39, O = 16, H = 1]

question: Avogadro Constant - Number of Molecules
stem: How many molecules are present in 0.25 mol of methane gas (CH4)? [Avogadro constant, L = 6.0 × 10²³ mol⁻¹]

question: Avogadro Constant - Total Atoms
stem: What is the total number of atoms present in 0.10 mol of sulfuric acid (H2SO4)? [Avogadro constant, L = 6.0 × 10²³ mol⁻¹]

question: Avogadro Constant - Number of Ions
stem: How many total ions are released when 0.50 mol of magnesium chloride (MgCl2) is dissolved completely in water? [Avogadro constant, L = 6.0 × 10²³ mol⁻¹]

question: Comparing Number of Molecules
stem: Which of the following gas samples contains the greatest number of molecules? [Ar: H = 1, C = 12, N = 14, O = 16]

question: Percentage Composition by Mass
stem: What is the percentage by mass of nitrogen in ammonium nitrate (NH4NO3)? [Ar: N = 14, H = 1, O = 16]

question: Water of Crystallisation Percentage
stem: What is the percentage by mass of water in hydrated copper(II) sulfate (CuSO4·5H2O)? [Ar: Cu = 64, S = 32, O = 16, H = 1]

question: Empirical Formula from Element Masses
stem: A hydrocarbon sample contains 4.8 g of carbon and 0.8 g of hydrogen. What is its empirical formula? [Ar: C = 12, H = 1]

question: Empirical Formula from Percentage
stem: An oxide of iron contains 70.0% iron and 30.0% oxygen by mass. What is its empirical formula? [Ar: Fe = 56, O = 16]

question: Empirical Formula from Combustion Data
stem: Complete combustion of a sample of a hydrocarbon produced 8.8 g of carbon dioxide and 5.4 g of water. What is the empirical formula of the hydrocarbon? [Ar: C = 12, H = 1, O = 16]

question: Molecular Formula Determination
stem: A compound has the empirical formula CH2O and a relative molecular mass (Mr) of 180. What is its molecular formula? [Ar: C = 12, H = 1, O = 16]

question: Hydrated Salt Formula Determination
stem: When 5.72 g of hydrated sodium carbonate crystals (Na2CO3·xH2O) is heated to constant mass, 2.12 g of anhydrous Na2CO3 remains. What is the value of x? [Mr: Na2CO3 = 106, H2O = 18]

question: Subatomic Particle Comparison
stem: Which of the following samples contains the exact same total number of electrons as 1.0 mol of neon gas (Ne)? [Atomic numbers: H = 1, C = 6, N = 7, O = 8, Ne = 10]

question: Deducing Unknown Relative Atomic Mass
stem: When 4.00 g of an anhydrous divalent metal carbonate (MCO3) is thermally decomposed completely, 0.96 dm³ of carbon dioxide gas is produced at r.t.p. What is the relative atomic mass (Ar) of metal M? [Ar: C = 12, O = 16]
